# Coding AI Prompt — Complete Landing Page (Privy Style Theme)

## 1. Project Overview & Deliverables

Build a complete, production-grade landing page from scratch using the **Privy editorial crypto-fintech visual style** (reused as a style reference only). Invent a fictional brand name, product, and all copy. Never use the real brand name "Privy", its logo, trademarks, or product names anywhere in the page.

**Deliverables (separate files, no inline CSS/JS beyond a single deferred script entry point):**
- `index.html` — semantic HTML5 structure
- `style.css` — all styling, CSS variables, themes, components
- `script.js` — theme toggle, FAQ accordion, mobile nav, smooth interactions

**Class naming convention:** BEM (Block__Element--Modifier). Never mix conventions.

---

## 2. Strict Architecture Rules

### 2.1 CSS-First & Zero Inline CSS
- All styling lives in `style.css`. Forbid `style="..."` attributes in HTML.
- Target all design via class/ID selectors only.
- Keep HTML clean, semantic, and agnostic of visual styling.

### 2.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens
Store all visual tokens in `:root` (and theme classes) using CSS variables. Required tokens:

**Colors (Light Mode defaults):**
- `--color-canvas: #ffffff`
- `--color-obsidian-ink: #010110`
- `--color-carbon: #111117`
- `--color-graphite: #22222a`
- `--color-fog: #73737c`
- `--color-ash: #d9d9d9`
- `--color-iris-pulse: #635bff`
- `--color-deep-teal: #072723`

Map to semantic tokens: `--primary`, `--secondary`, `--bg-primary`, `--bg-secondary`, `--text-primary`, `--text-secondary`, `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-default`, `--border-error`, `--border-success`.

**Contrast pairing:** Every light background token pairs with a dark text token; every dark background token pairs with a light text token — enforce in both themes.

**Light mode background:** Use `#fefefe` where a near-white is needed (never pure `#ffffff` for body background); canvas surfaces may use `#ffffff`.

**Border radius & shadows:** `--radius-sm: 2px`, `--radius-md: 8px`, `--radius-lg: 100px`, `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md` (shadows defined but used sparingly — flatness is deliberate).

**Spacing & transitions:** `--spacing-gap`, `--transition-fast: 150ms ease`, `--transition-normal: 200ms ease`, `--ease-standard: ease`.

**Elevation/stacking:** `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast`.

**Typography tokens:**
- `--font-base: 'Inter', sans-serif` (body/UI)
- `--font-display: 'Source Serif 4', serif` (display headlines — Google Fonts substitute for ABC Favorit)
- Type scale tokens: `--text-caption`, `--text-body-sm`, `--text-body`, `--text-subheading`, `--text-heading-sm`, `--text-heading`, `--text-heading-lg`, `--text-display` with sizes, line-heights, and letter-spacing per spec (e.g. display: 76px, lh 1.03, ls -2.28px; heading-lg: 56px, lh 1.07, ls -1.68px).

### 2.3 Mandatory Dark Mode
- Provide dark mode tokens under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` AND a `.dark` class selector.
- Background/text variables switch seamlessly without HTML restructuring.
- Persist user theme choice via `localStorage`, falling back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit.
- Include a visible toggle control with correct `aria-pressed`/`aria-label` state.
- Note: Privy uses dark surfaces as full-bleed sectional bands, not a global theme toggle. Implement dark mode tokens for the mandatory requirement, but keep the default light editorial canvas; dark bands (Carbon/Graphite) appear as sections regardless of theme.

### 2.4 Flexbox & Mobile-First
- All layouts use Flexbox (`display: flex`).
- Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless explicitly justified.
- Mobile-responsive out of the box: rows convert to columns on small viewports; no horizontal scrolling.

### 2.5 Framework
- Use Tailwind CSS via CDN (or clean custom CSS driven by Tailwind `@layer`/`@apply`). All utility classes map back to CSS variables or reusable classes (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`).

### 2.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)
- Text: Google Font links for **Inter** (400, 500, 700) and **Source Serif 4** (400). Bind to `--font-base` and `--font-display`.
- Icons: Google Material Symbols. Forbid raw inline SVGs or local icon files.

---

## 3. Component Design Specifications

### 3.1 Buttons
Style all states via CSS classes:
- **Default:** Flex, `align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem`. Min touch target 44x44px.
- **Hover:** Visual shift (brightness/shadow) + `cursor: pointer`.
- **Focus:** Distinct focus ring via CSS variables.
- **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)`.
- **Loading:** Disable interactions, prevent double-clicks, CSS spinner or animated Material Icon without distorting dimensions.
- **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, greyscale, `cursor: not-allowed`.
- **Success/Error:** Temporary feedback via `--text-success`/`--text-error`.

Variants:
- **Primary Filled:** `#010110` fill, white text, 15px Inter 500, ls -0.02em, padding 12px 20px, radius 100px, no border, no shadow. Arrow icon (→) at 14px, 6px gap.
- **Ghost Outline:** Transparent fill, 1px `#010110` border, `#010110` text, same padding/radius. Hover: fill `#010110`, text inverts to white.
- **Pill Link (Header):** Transparent fill, 1px white border, white text 13–14px Inter, padding 6px 14px, radius 100px.

### 3.2 Cards
- **Default:** Flexbox, `#ffffff` surface, 8px radius, 1px hairline border (`#010110` at reduced opacity), padding 24px.
- **Hover:** `transform: translateY(-2px)` + subtle shadow shift.
- **Focus-within:** Highlight border on child focus.
- **Loading (Skeleton):** CSS shimmer animation, no layout jump.
- **Empty State:** Google Icon + guidance text.

Dark feature cards: `#22222a` background on `#111117` section, 8px radius, padding 24–32px, no border/shadow, heading Inter 500 18–20px white, body Inter 400 14–15px `#73737c`.

### 3.3 Forms & Inputs
States: Empty, Focused (outline ring), Filled, Valid (success border/icon), Invalid (error border, red text, error icon), Disabled, Read-only. Structure: flex container wrapping label, input, error feedback.

### 3.4 Modal / Popup
States: Opening, Open, Loading, Success/Error, Closing (CSS transitions). Centered flex (`align-items: center`), backdrop overlay, Material Icon close button, focus trapping, close via Esc/overlay click.

---

## 4. Core UX & Micro-Interactions

- **Responsive by default:** Fluid sizing, breakpoints, no horizontal overflow.
- **Smooth animations:** CSS transitions on all state changes (`transition: var(--transition-normal)`), respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- **Accessibility:** Sufficient contrast in both themes. Never rely solely on color for state. Semantic HTML5, correct ARIA roles/labels, logical DOM/focus order, full keyboard operability, `aria-live` regions for dynamic feedback.
- **Mandatory visual feedback:** Every click/hover/submission triggers visible state change.
- **Destructive actions:** Distinct `.btn-danger` in both themes.

---

## 5. Landing Page Sections (in order)

1. **Announcement Bar** — full-width `#635bff` band, padding 10px 24px, centered text Inter 500 13px white. Right-aligned inline pill link (transparent, 1px white border, white text 13px, padding 6px 14px, radius 100px, → arrow). Place ABOVE nav.
2. **Navigation Bar** — white bg, 1px bottom border `#010110` at 15% opacity, height 64px. Logo left: 8px black dot + brand name Inter 700 16px `#010110`, ls -0.02em. Optional suffix 13px Inter 400 `#73737c`. Center nav: items with 14px icon above 13px Inter label, 10px row-gap, `#010110`. Right cluster: text links + 'Log in' ghost pill button. Mobile: hamburger.
3. **Hero** — white bg, max-width 1200px centered. Two-column: left = headline (Source Serif 4, weight 400, 56–76px, `#010110`, ls -0.03em, lh 1.03–1.07) + subtext (Inter 400, 18px, `#73737c`) + dual CTAs (filled primary + ghost, pill). Right = abstract painted wash (green/teal) with overlapping phone + dashboard mockups at slight angle. Use CSS gradients/placeholders for artwork (no real images required; use CSS shapes).
4. **Logo Strip** — horizontal partner brand logos on white (use text placeholders styled as logos).
5. **Features** — 3 cards. White bg, 3-column grid, 8px radius cards, hairline borders. Each: icon (Material Symbol), heading Inter 500 18–20px `#010110`, body Inter 400 14–15px `#73737c`.
6. **How It Works** — 3 steps, numbered, Inter typography, white bg, centered layout.
7. **Testimonials** — cards with quote, name, role. White bg, 8px radius.
8. **Pricing** — 3 tiers. Cards with price, features list, CTA button. Highlight middle tier with `#010110` border or subtle bg shift.
9. **FAQ** — accordion, keyboard accessible, `aria-expanded`, smooth height transition.
10. **Final CTA** — centered headline (Source Serif 4) + subtext + primary button. White bg or subtle wash.
11. **Footer** — white bg with `#d9d9d9` dotted halftone pattern at 20% opacity covering top 60%. 4-column link grid: headings Inter 700 14px `#010110`, links Inter 400 14px `#73737c`, row-gap 10px. Bottom row: copyright Inter 12px `#73737c`, social icons 16px `#010110` right-aligned, brand quote Inter 14px.

---

## 6. Style Constraints (Do's & Don'ts)

**Do:**
- Use Source Serif 4 (Google Font) for all display headlines ≥26px; never Inter at display sizes.
- Set display headlines weight 400, ls -0.03em, lh 1.03–1.15.
- Use `#010110` for all filled primary buttons; violet reserved for announcement bar + links only.
- Reserve `#635bff` for exactly: announcement bar fill, inline link hover, decorative chart strokes.
- Pill radius (100px) for buttons/tags; 8px for cards/images; 2px for icons.
- Hairline 1px borders in `#010110` at reduced opacity for dividers/card edges.
- Place Iris Pulse announcement bar full-bleed above nav.

**Don't:**
- Don't use `#635bff` as CTA button fill.
- Don't set headlines in Inter at 40px+.
- Don't add drop shadows to cards/buttons (flat surfaces, hairline borders, tone shifts).
- Don't introduce additional accent colors.
- Don't use ls above -0.02em body / -0.03em display.
- Don't use dark surface palette on light-mode pages (dark is sectional).
- Don't mix radius values between 8px and 100px.

---

## 7. Imagery & Decoration

- Minimal editorial: abstract green/teal painted wash in hero (CSS gradient/shape), 3D isometric line-art in dark feature section (`#333`–`#444` strokes on `#22222a`), phone/dashboard mockups as white frames with realistic UI inside.
- Iconography: monochrome outlined, 16–20px, stroke 1.5px (Material Symbols).
- No photography, no lifestyle imagery, no decorative gradients beyond specified washes.

---

## 8. Final Notes

- All copy must be invented for the fictional brand; no real brand references.
- Ensure full keyboard navigation, focus rings, and `aria-live` for dynamic feedback.
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Output only the three files with clean, well-commented code. No preamble.
